adjudication.rationale: Yes. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` is computed with `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)`, which is a case-sensitive comparison. Since neither `guest` nor `attendee.email` is normalized (e.g., lowercased) before comparison, an existing attendee `a@b.com` would not match an input `A@B.com`, allowing a duplicate attendee differing only by case to be added. This is directly verifiable from the diff and is a real correctness issue (also affects the blacklist check, which lowercases blacklist entries but not the incoming `guest`).
